hook: Six American banks collapsed in 2026, leaving regulators to manage closures.

sections.voiceover: Six American banks collapsed in 2026, leaving regulators to manage closures.
In Lenexa, Kansas, Small Business Bank failed on July 17 with 73 million dollars in assets. What specific institutions were involved in these six total bank failures during 2026?
But the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, the government agency protecting deposits, managed every single closure.
Nano Banc in Irvine, California, was one of these six, closing on September 25, 2026. These events confirmed the total of six bank failures recorded throughout the year 2026.
Six banks vanished from the market throughout 2026.
